channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood
item.description: Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm. The dates are Saturday 12, Sunday 13, Saturday 19, Sunday 20, Monday 21 and Wednesday 23 December. Children's tickets cost £16 and include a children's breakfast and a drink, Christmas craft and colour

item.title: Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood
item.description: Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road. The family-friendly event features traditional Christmas carols, a chance for children to meet Santa, and complimentary snacks and drinks. Entry is free, but the church advises booking in advance. B

item.title: Schofield Street, roadworks in Heywood from 20 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Schofield Street in Heywood; expected timings: Work began at 8am on Friday, 20 November 2026 and will continue for a maximum of 21 days (11 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Newhey mother receives hundreds of birthday cards after son’s appeal
item.description: Wendy Bamford, 79, celebrated her birthday at Springhill Hospice, receiving an outpouring of cards and gifts following her son's heartfelt request on social media.

item.title: Rochdale Masters and Mayfield Movers raise nearly £15,000 in charity walks
item.description: The Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers have raised £14,698.67 for charity through two fundraising walks, with proceeds supporting community rugby and health initiatives.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 20 November 2026
item.description: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Tributes paid to Obesi Osi-Iyere, 20, former Cardinal Langley student
item.description: Obesi Osi-Iyere, a talented playwright and former student at Cardinal Langley RC High School, has died at the age of 20.

item.title: Photographer captures tranquil views of the Rochdale Canal at Todmorden
item.description: A photograph by cookyphil showcases the scenic beauty of the Rochdale Canal at Todmorden, highlighting its appeal for locals and visitors alike.

item.title: Greater Manchester trial targets prolific shoplifters with new programme
item.description: A new initiative in Greater Manchester aims to tackle prolific shoplifting through coordinated efforts from police, probation services, and local councils.

item.title: Rochdale AFC launches Christmas Toy Appeal for local families in need
item.description: Rochdale AFC is calling on fans to donate gifts for its Christmas Toy Appeal, aiming to support local children living in poverty this festive season.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council establishes Integrated Commissioning Board
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has established the Integrated Commissioning Board to enhance health and social care services across the borough. This decision aims to improve the integration of services for better care delivery.

item.title: Winter Wood Grotto returns to Rochdale with new seasonal show
item.description: The Winter Wood Grotto, a festive tradition in Rochdale, is back with a new woodland-themed show created by Cornwall’s Rogue Otherworld.

item.title: Rochdale AFC reduces ticket prices for FA Cup tie against Newport County
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced reduced ticket prices for their FA Cup match against Newport County on 5 December at Crown Oil Arena.

item.title: St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale placed in special measures after Ofsted inspection
item.description: St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale has been placed in special measures following an Ofsted inspection that highlighted serious safety issues and a lack of effective leadership.

item.title: Person dies on tracks at Todmorden station, disrupting services to Rochdale
item.description: A person has died on the tracks at Todmorden station, affecting train services between Rochdale and Hebden Bridge.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 19 November 2026
item.description: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Life Without Limits gym relocates to new premises in Littleborough
item.description: Life Without Limits fitness centre has received planning permission to move to a larger facility on Stockton Street, allowing for expansion and new services.

item.title: Rochdale house prices rise by 4.1% over the past year
item.description: House prices in Rochdale have increased by 4.1% over the past year, with the average home now costing £213,000, according to the latest data from the Office for National Statistics.

item.title: Rochdale restaurant's Sunday roast named among the best in the UK
item.description: The Martlet in Rochdale has been recognised for its exceptional Sunday roast in a national ranking by the Good Food Guide.

item.title: Rochdale's Springhill Hospice wins three garden awards
item.description: An 18-strong volunteer gardening team has helped Springhill Hospice win three awards, including Best Hospice Garden in the North West 2026.

item.title: Healey Dell tearooms win North West in Bloom gold for fifth year running
item.description: Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms has won North West in Bloom gold for a fifth year, and this year also took home a trophy.

item.title: Rochdale MP seeks local role in pilot targeting repeat shoplifters
item.description: Greater Manchester has been selected for a programme targeting repeat shop theft, but the locations have yet to be decided. Paul Waugh wants Rochdale included.

item.title: Rochdale man jailed for life for murdering wife and hiding her body
item.description: A Rochdale man has been sentenced to life in prison for murdering his wife, whose body he concealed under their bed for two days.

item.title: Rochdale Metrolink patrols target knife crime during Sceptre week
item.description: Town centre PCSOs have patrolled the tram route between Newbold and Rochdale town centre as part of the national knife crime campaign.

item.title: Investigation launched after death of three-year-old boy at Middleton nursery
item.description: A three-year-old boy has died following an incident at Cosy Toes Nursery in Middleton, prompting a police investigation and the nursery's closure.

item.title: World armwrestling champion Agi Gorzyńska to take on challengers at Rochdale's Grushka House
item.description: The three-time world champion will lead four free taster sessions on Drake Street on Sunday 6 December, with booking required for everyone.

item.title: Falinge Park High School celebrates Artsmark Week with students
item.description: Falinge Park High School recently hosted an Artsmark Celebration Week, recognising the contributions of students in Years 7 to 10. The event took place over the past week and aimed to highlight the importance of cultural education for all learners.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 18 November 2026
item.description: 12 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Winter Wood Grotto returns to Rochdale Cenotaph with new theme
item.description: The Winter Wood Grotto event at Rochdale Cenotaph will feature a new theme called The Wild, offering seasonal fun and storytelling.

item.title: Rochdale man denies machete possession and window damage charges in Bury
item.description: Mayson Oldham, 21, of Balderstone Road, Rochdale, pleaded not guilty to charges of possessing a machete and damaging windows in Bury during a court appearance.

item.title: Dawson Street, roadworks in Heywood from 16 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Dawson Street in Heywood; expected timings: The restriction began at 6.23pm on Monday, 16 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (8 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Husband-and-wife pottery studio expands in Rochdale town centre
item.description: Clay & Glaze, a pottery painting studio in Rochdale, has grown from two to five employees in just over a year and has received local awards.

item.title: Rochdale Council plans £5.6m improvement for temporary accommodation
item.description: Rochdale Council has announced a £5.6m plan to improve temporary accommodation for families, addressing the needs of 387 households currently in such housing.

item.title: Greater Manchester Police seeks exceptional financial support from government
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has applied for exceptional financial support due to rising demands and pressures on resources, with plans for a meeting with the Home Secretary.

item.title: LIVE: No injuries reported after suspected gas explosion at Bamford house as emergency services remain
item.description: Police and the fire service say no injuries have been reported after a suspected gas explosion at a house in Bamford at around 4.30pm. Bury Road is closed from Midgehall Drive to Woodtop Avenue.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards £4.8 million health improvement contract
item.description: The Big Life Company Limited has been awarded a contract to provide health improvement services in Rochdale, valued at £4.8 million.

item.title: Enchanted woodland event returns to Rochdale with festive performances
item.description: The immersive woodland event, created by Rogue Otherworld, will take place on 29 November, featuring storytelling and seasonal fun for families.

item.title: Rochdale Council approves demolition of seven modernist tower blocks
item.description: Rochdale Council has approved the demolition of seven modernist tower blocks as part of a regeneration initiative aimed at improving the local environment and paving the way for new developments.

item.title: Littleborough Brass Bands Association Christmas Concert
item.description: Join Littleborough Brass Bands Association for a festive evening of Christmas favourites, featuring all three bands. Great music, seasonal cheer and a licensed bar! St Andrews Church, Arm Rd, Littleborough OL15 8NJ, UK

item.title: Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 celebrate community champions
item.description: The Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 took place at Middleton Arena, recognising the contributions of local coaches, volunteers, and young athletes.

item.title: Former Clean Air Zone cameras now used by police to fight crime across Greater Manchester
item.description: Around 400 number plate cameras put up for the scrapped Clean Air Zone have been handed to Greater Manchester Police, with a senior officer saying they have led to multiple arrests.

item.title: Rochdale teenagers born in 2009 or later will never be legally sold tobacco from 1 January
item.description: The generational smoking ban starts on 1 January 2027, making it an offence to sell tobacco to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009.

item.title: Hiram Boateng charged with affray after pitch invasion incident during York City-Rochdale match
item.description: Former MK Dons midfielder Hiram Boateng faces charges following an altercation with a fan during a pitch invasion at a match against Rochdale.

item.title: Heywood homes left without power after cable fault during snow warning
item.description: Sixty-five properties in north Heywood lost power on Tuesday morning, with engineers aiming to restore supplies by 12.30pm.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 17 November 2026
item.description: 11 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Rochdale Hornets close in on squad completion ahead of new season
item.description: The Rochdale Hornets are finalising their squad for the upcoming season, with key signings and contract talks ongoing.

item.title: Clover Hall Crescent, roadworks in Rochdale from 17 November 2026
item.description: Roadworks on Clover Hall Crescent in Rochdale will temporarily close part of the road from 17 to 21 November 2026.

item.title: Friend backs Springhill Hospice Christmas appeal after Leanne Field’s last Minions party
item.description: Sally Kerr is backing Springhill Hospice’s Christmas appeal in memory of her best friend Leanne Field, 45, who had one last party at the Rochdale hospice two days before she died.

item.title: Seven Sisters to be demolished as RBH plans around 600 new homes at College Bank
item.description: All seven College Bank tower blocks will come down, with a planning application for around 600 new homes expected in early 2027. RBH expects every remaining customer to have moved out by summer 2027.

item.title: Kyle Howard pleads guilty to murder of wife Keeley Aspinall in Rochdale
item.description: Kyle Howard, 37, of Tweedale Street, Rochdale, admitted murdering his wife Keeley Aspinall, 44, at Manchester Crown Court and will be sentenced on Wednesday 18 November.
